nodes.name: Catch AP error
nodes.notes: Native Error Trigger for unexpected production workflow failures. Set this under the main workflow Error workflow setting; no n8n API key is needed.

nodes.name: Prepare safe error
nodes.notes: Log workflow/node/type only, never chat content, customer identity, original provider errors, credentials or stacks.

nodes.name: Log AP error
nodes.notes: Insert safe metadata in existing postcall_errors. Credential: AP Supabase. A database logging failure still attempts the admin alert.

nodes.notes: Internal metadata-only alert. Select AP Slack, set admin channel ID and invite the bot. Never send raw invoice content in this alert.
